messages.author: 68ea602ee745cb2a
messages.subject: Geomorph, Stereomorph and CVA
parts:
Hy everyone,

I digitized my landmark data using a Stereomorph, and my analysis is running in Geomorph. But in moment, I need a execute a CVA em my 2d data.

Someone know how I can do it using my landmark data, obtained in Stereomorph/Geomorph?

Sorry about my english. Is not my native language.

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Geomorph, Stereomorph and CVA
parts:
Mateus,

after performing a gpa of your data to extract shape variables, you can do a CVA with the general functions available for that (e.g. function lda in package MASS), after somehow removing the redundant dimensions in your data that result from the gpa. However, as GM data are particular, I would recommend you rather look at bayesian classification methods, i.e. available through the function classify in the package RRPP.

Hope this helps

Antigoni
